conventions.convention: The undeformed algebra is commutative, unital and real. Formal products are coefficientwise, preserve the specified unit, and impose no numerical convergence.
The bivector bracket is π^{ij}f_i g_j, with π = (1/2)π^{ij}∂ᵢ∧∂ⱼ and Schouten self-bracket components 2J^{ijk}. Degenerate and zero bivectors are allowed.
Cochains have positive arity p and shifted degree p−1; insertion into slot i starts at i=0 and carries sign (−1)^{(q−1)i}. The standard Hochschild differential is δ.
The DGLA differential is ∂=[m,−], with ∂φ=(−1)^{p−1}δφ for a p-cochain. Thus ∂B=−δB for binary cochains and ∂O=δO for ternary cochains.
Star products satisfy B₁(f,g)−B₁(g,f)={f,g}π with a real formal parameter and no implicit factor of i.
Gauge transformations satisfy f⋆′g=T⁻¹(Tf⋆Tg), where T=id+ΣħʳDᵣ and Dᵣ(1)=0; hence T maps the primed algebra to the unprimed algebra.
The obstruction lies in normalized multidifferential Hochschild cohomology, n≥2, and extension through order n means associativity modulo ħ^{n+1}.

load_bearing.statement: For a unital associative real algebra, Lʲ=C^{j+1}(A,A), j≥0, with Gerstenhaber bracket and ∂=[m,−], is a differential graded Lie algebra; ∂φ=(−1)^{p−1}δφ. For smooth-function algebras, normalized multidifferential cochains are closed under δ and the bracket.

The local bivector brackets agree on coordinate overlaps and define a real Poisson-algebra bracket on C∞(M,R) exactly when every J^{ijk} vanishes; equivalently, [π,π]SN=0. No nondegeneracy or choice axiom is used.
For a formal associative deformation of a commutative unital real algebra A, β(f,g)=B₁(f,g)−B₁(g,f) is a real Poisson-algebra bracket on A.

If normalized bidifferential B₁,…,Bₙ₋₁ give a product associative modulo ħⁿ, n≥2, then Oₙ=Σᵢ₌₁ⁿ⁻¹(Bᵢ(Bₙ₋ᵢ(f,g),h)−Bᵢ(f,Bₙ₋ᵢ(g,h))) is a normalized multidifferential Hochschild 3-cocycle. A normalized bidifferential extension Bₙ exists exactly when [Oₙ]=0, with extension equation δBₙ=Oₙ.
A formal associative deformation of a commutative unital real algebra is a coefficientwise associative product with B₀=m, real-bilinear Bᵣ, and specified unit 1.
